name: Chris Rock
note: STAGE PERSONA graph. Graph-only (no personality.md yet). 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Fingerprints ≤7 words, no verbatim lines.

identity.deal: Rhythm preacher who paces the stage like a heart attack and makes the room say 'I know, right' out loud before they can stop themselves.
identity.premise: A high-strung philosopher who treats every social observation like a case he's prosecuting in front of a jury that's already leaning his way.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware, fully in control, but the persona runs HOT — unlike Seinfeld's cool auditor or Chappelle's calm king. Rock's awareness is a prosecution strategy, not a distance.

philosophy.ontology: The world runs on unexamined contradictions and somebody has to pace back and point at them.
philosophy.epistemology: Everybody sees it; the trick is the rhythm that makes them admit it.
philosophy.axiology: The loudest true thing beats the quietest clever thing.
philosophy.causality: A contradiction named at the right tempo becomes undeniable.
philosophy.agency: One comic pacing hard enough can make a room uncomfortable with its own agreement.

dramatic_core.want: the room's vocal agreement — the 'I know' moment
dramatic_core.fear: the quiet room, the unexamined nod
dramatic_core.need: one more contradiction dragged into the light at full volume

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats any social contradiction as an unfinished trial: if he paces it out loud fast enough, the room becomes the jury and the verdict is the laugh.
contradictions: the class clown who became the culture's lecturer
preaches to the choir and makes the choir sing along without noticing

status_model.desired_status: the voice that names it first
status_model.felt_status: legend still pacing like he's got something to prove

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the energy is the weapon
tells: the stammer-start that becomes the point

profile.pace: fast, staccato, hard stops on the punch

threads: the gap between what we say and what we do
identity.style_thesis: Rhythm-prosecutor engine: treats the contradiction nobody names as a crime scene and prosecutes it with the rhythm of a preacher. The stammer-build is the indictment; the hard-stop punch is the verdict. The 'I know' wave is the jury's response.

engine.archetype_def: per archetypes.json — grievance engine; offense as rocket fuel. Chappelle/Rock adjacent but Rock is higher-energy, more rhythmic, less story-driven than the archetype's Casey/Ari examples.

timing_profile.hypothesis: sprints and stammers INTO the point (fast, high-energy, the stammer-as-build), hard-stop on the punch, short hold for the 'I know' wave, restart before it dies. The rhythm is percussive — closer to a rapper's cadence than a storyteller's. Contrast Chappelle (holds forever after the point) — Rock fills the hold with the next attack.
stop_start: start: the prosecution begins, pace hot
stammer-build: the digression IS the rhythm
hold: short — just long enough for the 'I know' wave
restart: next charge, before the wave dies
timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Stammer-build, hard-stop punch, short hold for the 'I know' wave. The stammer is the windup; the hard stop is the punch landing; the short hold is the room's recognition catching up.

gtvh_profile.SO: normal/absurd — social edition: the normal is absurd once prosecuted at tempo
gtvh_profile.LM: double_interpret + juxtapose — the contradiction is usually two true things held side by side until they indict each other
gtvh_profile.TA: peers / powerful / social groups — prosecutes systems and in-groups; self-targeting is rare and strategic
gtvh_profile.NS: monologue-list / anecdote — rapid-fire examples building to the verdict

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Chris Rock: 'The contradiction nobody names' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Names a thing everyone knows but nobody says. split_knowledge: the room has the knowledge; he's the one who says it out loud. The laugh is the alliance signal — 'yes, that's true, and I'm glad someone said it.'
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Chris Rock: 'The stammer-build' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: The stammer is not a flaw — it's the windup. The room leans in because he seems to be losing his train of thought; the hard-stop punch arrives where they didn't expect. garden_path: the stammer is the misdirection.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
